keySentence: His sisters went to pick berries.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The sisters walked together. They found berries. They picked many berries. His sisters went to pick berries.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Flopsy, Mopsy, and Cotton-tail walked down the sunny lane. The birds were singing and butterflies flew around them. They found a beautiful berry bush by the path. His sisters went to pick berries and fill their basket. They wanted to bring the berries home for Mother. Meanwhile, poor Peter was resting alone in his bed.
facts.Word cards: sisters = 자매들 / pick = 따다 / berries = 베리 / lane = 오솔길
